free_tier.stated: No free plan: the legacy keyless service at geoplugin.net answers HTTP 403 and says the API is no longer available for free use; the pricing page says there is no free trial and the cheapest plan, Basic, allows 100 requests a day at USD 10 a month.
free_tier.notes: Basic is shown as USD 10 a month, or USD 8 a month with the annual option; Starter is USD 25 (1,000 a day), Professional USD 50 (5,000 a day), Business USD 100 (20,000 a day) and Enterprise USD 200 (100,000 a day), each with a cheaper annual price.

retention.stated: not stated for the keyed API

interface_detail: GET https://api.geoplugin.com/?ip=ADDRESS&auth=KEY and GET https://api.geoplugin.com/me?auth=KEY, with an optional lang parameter; JSON with geoplugin_* fields; a call with no key answers HTTP 400 No API key provided; the legacy http://www.geoplugin.net/json.gp answers HTTP 403
chaining: No free route: the cheapest keyed plan is Basic, 100 requests a day for USD 10 a month, and cached responses do not count against the daily limit. Bulk path: none stated

limits.value: 100 requests a day on the Basic plan, reset at midnight UTC; cached responses do not count

binding_note: The plan's daily count is the only stated limit for the keyed API; past it calls continue but may be throttled.

identity_cost.detail: registration takes an email address and a password (full name optional) or Google sign-in; every API plan is paid by card or PayPal, and there is no free plan or trial

reliability_note: Third-party reports of the same 403 message date from 2025-09-01.
confidence_note: The legacy endpoint's HTTP 403 answer was read through a fetch, and a keyless call to the keyed API answered HTTP 400. Two third-party reports (2025-09-01 and 2026-02-22) give the same 403 message. No keyed lookup was made.
